title: Zero‐Strain Insertion Material of Li [ Li1 / 3Ti5 / 3 ] O 4 for Rechargeable Lithium Cells
abstract: having a defect spinel‐framework structure was prepared and examined in non‐aqueous lithium cells. X‐ray diffraction measurements indicated that the lattice dimension did not change during the reaction Since the reaction consists of lithium ion and electron insertion into/extraction from the solid matrix without a noticeable change in lattice dimension, called a zero‐strain insertion reaction, capacity failure due to the damage to the solid matrix was not observed even after 100 cycles. Feasibility of zero‐strain insertion materials for advanced batteries is discussed based on the experimental results.
